div.head: Leis Wl 30
div.ab: Les naifs ki *departet de sa terre ne devient cartre faire nauvrie quere* que il ne facent lur dreit service que apend a lour terre.
Peasants born on estates [must not withdraw from their estates or seek an excuse] for not carrying out the (form of) legal service which obtains on their estate.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 268–269 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; The text between asterisks is corrupt (Robertson); the bracketed words of the translation follow L: Nativi non recedant a terris suis nec querant ingenium unde dominum suum debito servitio suo defraudent.
